text: Refund policy. Customers in India are eligible for a full refund within 30 days of purchase, provided the product is unused and in its original packaging. To request a refund, email support@example.com with your order ID. Refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days to the original payment method. Items purchased during clearance sales are final sale and cannot be refunded.

Parental leave policy India. As per the Maternity Benefit Act, women employees are entitled to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave for the first two children. Paternity leave is 15 days of paid leave, to be availed within 6 months of the child's birth. Employees must notify HR at least 8 weeks before the expected date of leave.

Warranty terms. All electronics sold in India carry a 2 year manufacturer warranty covering manufacturing defects and hardware failures under normal use. The warranty does not cover accidental damage, water damage, or unauthorised repairs. To claim warranty service, register your product within 30 days of purchase and retain the invoice.

Shipping policy United States. Standard shipping within the United States takes 3 to 5 business days and costs $4.99. Express shipping delivers in 1 to 2 business days for $12.99. Orders over $50 qualify for free standard shipping. International shipping rates are calculated at checkout.

Pricing and discounts. New customers receive a 10 percent discount on their first order with code WELCOME10. Student discount is 15 percent with valid verification. Discounts cannot be combined. Prices are listed in INR for Indian customers and include GST.
